title: Release Notes
summary: Added customizable swipe-left actions for notes, support for the 0.30 API, log export on the login page, and an open-source app font.
Improved tag display on Memo cards and text selection in the classic editor.
Fixed the screen turning off during recording and the WebDAV server address layout.

contents: Added swipe-left actions for notes, customizable in Labs
Added a log export entry point to the login page
Added an open-source font for the app
Improved tag display on Memo cards
Improved text-selection interactions in the classic editor
Fixed the screen turning off automatically during recording
Fixed the WebDAV server address layout
